blocks.text: SACRAMENTO, California — Dillon Brooks and Devin Booker scored 29 points apiece as the Phoenix Suns defeated Sacramento 128-107 in the NBA Wednesday night, sending the Kings to their seventh straight loss. Phoenix has won the first two games of its five-game trip. The Suns have won six of their last eight games to reach .500 at 7-7 after a 1-5 start.
